# HITL.cc — Human-in-the-Loop Computer Control

> HITL is the approval layer between AI agents and irreversible actions.
> An agent proposes the exact operation; a human approves or denies; only
> then does it execute. Autonomy for the work, human authority for the
> consequences.

## What HITL is

Human-in-the-loop (HITL) computer control: AI agents run autonomously on
your hardware — files, code, inboxes, payments — but every consequential
action routes through a checkpoint that waits for explicit human
approval. Nothing sensitive commits without your yes.

## Why it matters

An agent with total control can delete files, transfer funds, leak
credentials, or act on poisoned input (prompt injection via email,
documents, calendar invites) — irreversibly and unwitnessed. HITL is the
checkpoint between the plan and the action.

## Implementation

HITL is implemented end to end by VIMS (https://vims.com), a private
super intelligence that runs on your own hardware. The agent drafts the
operation, you approve with a tap or a voice command — from your desk or
from anywhere — and the action executes only after your signature.
